item.title: Intune’s China planning guidance and iOS wrapping prerequisite links are refreshed — 26 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 26 November 2026

Intune’s China planning guidance and iOS wrapping prerequisite links are refreshed

The period was documentation-led, with one concrete prerequisite-link replacement and two planning-guidance revisions. The China and Government Service updates sharpen how administrators should interpret feature availability, unsupported capabilities, and roadmap information.

Intune · Apple

iOS App Wrapping Tool prerequisites now use the Microsoft Security Blog link

The provisioning-profile instructions replace the former TechNet URL with a Microsoft Security Blog URL. Administrators referencing prerequisites for the Intune App Wrapping Tool for iOS should use the updated link.

Intune · Fundamentals

China deployment guidance reorganizes feature availability and management links

The Intune operated by 21Vianet article now directs readers to supported, unavailable, and planned features, presents feature differences in a table, and updates deployment and Windows management links. Use this revised material when planning device and app management deployments in China.

Intune · Fundamentals

Government Service guidance makes unsupported-feature and roadmap limits explicit

The guidance now states that its unsupported-features list is not comprehensive, provides directional information about planned investments, and notes that plans, target dates, and capabilities may change. Use the list as planning guidance rather than a complete or fixed roadmap.

item.title: Intune flags January 2027 enrollment and Data Warehouse reporting changes — 23 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 23 November 2026

Intune flags January 2027 enrollment and Data Warehouse reporting changes

Two Intune Message Center notices outline planned changes for January 2027: a revised web-based enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS and updated policy-related reporting in Intune Data Warehouse. Both notices say existing administrators do not need to take action.

Intune · Device enrollment

Intune · Compliance

Intune Data Warehouse policy reporting collections will change January 4

Policy-related reporting collections will be updated, which may alter policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and differences from Intune admin center reports may reflect timing and aggregation.

item.title: Android per-app VPN guidance flags unsupported Intune-deployed line-of-business apps — 21 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 21 November 2026

Android per-app VPN guidance flags unsupported Intune-deployed line-of-business apps

The period is led by a newly stated Android Enterprise per-app VPN limitation: Android line-of-business apps deployed directly through Intune aren't supported. Windows Hello for Business guidance adds a concrete policy-alignment and Company Portal sync sequence, while dedicated-device and custom-compliance pages sharpen setup details. All seven entries are Microsoft Learn updates; no new or removed items are listed.

Intune · Android

Android Enterprise per-app VPN support limitation is explicitly documented

The VPN reference now states that Android line-of-business apps deployed directly through Intune aren't supported for per-app VPN.

Intune · Device enrollment

Windows Hello guidance adds PIN-policy alignment and Company Portal sync

The article adds guidance to align Windows Hello for Business settings with configuration-policy PIN settings, then have users sync in Company Portal so the PIN policy applies correctly.

Intune · Device enrollment

Dedicated-device guidance documents Shared Device Mode enrollment behavior

The setup guidance explains that Android Enterprise dedicated devices with Shared Device Mode automatically receive Microsoft Authenticator and Company Portal, enroll without a user account, and use Microsoft Entra shared device mode for SSO across participating apps.

Intune · Device security

Custom compliance discovery scripts drop the documented 64-bit PowerShell host setting

The Windows instructions no longer list the 64-bit PowerShell host setting. The page also received wording, link, capitalization, and formatting edits.

Intune · Compliance

Compliance retirement guidance and notification customization instructions are revised

The compliance-policy article clarifies retire-list and device-retirement instructions and reformats the notification email customization settings.

item.title: Windows Autopilot guidance adds OOBE timing and false ESP-failure scenarios — 19 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 19 November 2026

Windows Autopilot guidance adds OOBE timing and false ESP-failure scenarios

The period’s meaningful updates refine Windows Autopilot troubleshooting guidance and document the staged rollout timing for Intune local actions on Android. Two Autopilot entries address delayed policy retrieval during OOBE and misleading failure reports after successful pre-provisioning.

Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment

Autopilot guidance documents delayed organizational settings during OOBE

The Known Issues guidance now says associated devices can enter OOBE before organizational settings are downloaded and applied. TPM attestation and local device association can delay policy retrieval by about a minute, which may briefly expose OOBE pages configured to be skipped or delay device renaming after reset.

Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment

Autopilot reports can show false failures after successful ESP completion

The guidance now describes reports showing Failure with a 0–1 second duration even though pre-provisioning and ESP completed successfully. A nonblocking Win32 app error is being treated as ESP-blocking in the report; the device remains enrolled and functional.

Intune · Android

Android local actions rollout timing is now documented

The Intune Android local actions article now states that the capability is rolling out gradually, with availability for all customers expected by the end of November 2026, although the timing may change.

item.title: Intune documents Windows Server Insider pilots as CIS audit baselines enter preview — 17 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 17 November 2026

Intune documents Windows Server Insider pilots as CIS audit baselines enter preview

The period’s most consequential Intune updates establish a documented, nonproduction management path for eligible Windows Server Insider Preview builds and introduce a Windows 11 CIS benchmark audit profile. Intune also adds guidance for managed Google Account authentication on Android Enterprise devices, while Remote Help documents consent-based device diagnostic sharing. Configuration Manager release notes add concrete certificate and HTTPS distribution-point failure scenarios. Most remaining updates are routine wording, formatting, navigation, and screenshot maintenance.

Intune · Device enrollment

Windows Server Insider Preview gets a documented Intune pilot path

A new end-to-end guide covers enrollment, configuration, compliance, apps, updates, verification, prerequisites, and supported server types for Windows Server Insider Preview vNext. The scenario is explicitly for testing and evaluation, and Server Core is unsupported.

Intune · Device security

CIS audit profiles assess 404 Windows 11 settings without remediation

The new audit workflow creates and assigns a CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark profile covering Level 1, Level 2, and BitLocker checks. Administrators can review and export findings; the profile assesses configuration without configuring or remediating devices.

Intune · Android

Managed Google Account authentication guidance expands across Android Enterprise

A new article explains how to require managed Google Account authentication on supported corporate-owned and personally owned Android Enterprise devices, including prerequisites, enrollment types, policy creation, and assignment steps.

Remote Help · Troubleshooting

Remote Help sessions can expose consented device diagnostic reports

Helpers can request permission to view and potentially store a sharer’s diagnostic data. After consent, both participants can view the report and the helper can refresh it; reported information includes device, hardware, network, performance, security, update, storage, and peripheral details.

Configuration Manager · General

Configuration Manager documents certificate and HTTPS distribution-point failures

Release notes describe task-sequence status-message failures after Windows PE when boot media uses CNG/KSP certificates, plus HTTP 403.7 content-download failures from PKI HTTPS distribution points. The documented responses include recreating media with a legacy CSP-backed RSA certificate and temporarily adjusting IIS client-certificate settings for diagnosis.

View all updates for 17 November 2026 →

item.title: Company Portal minimum rises to v5.2608.0 on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS in February 2027 — 16 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 16 November 2026

Company Portal minimum rises to v5.2608.0 on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS in February 2027

The period’s clearest administrator deadline is the February 2027 Company Portal minimum. Alongside that forward-looking change, Intune guidance adds concrete Android Enterprise Local Actions permissions, records macOS Platform SSO enrollment prerequisites, and documents Windows targeting and protected-app additions. Windows Autopilot material also clarifies recovery-key access for reused devices; several other edits are terminology or reference updates.

Intune · Device enrollment

Company Portal minimum version moves to v5.2608.0 in February 2027

Starting in February 2027, the minimum iOS/iPadOS and macOS Company Portal version will be v5.2608.0. Most users update automatically, but users whose app installation is blocked may need a manual update; Microsoft advises informing helpdesk staff and pushing updates where device restrictions are enabled.

Intune · Android

Android Local Actions guidance adds app permissions and deployment limits

The OEMConfig guidance now covers permissions for both Managed Home Screen and the Intune app in Local Actions scenarios. It adds package names, permission details, prerequisites, supported OEMs, role requirements, and a 500-KB profile limit; when Local Actions and Managed Home Screen are used together, overlay permission is required for both apps.

Intune · General

Platform SSO enrollment guidance now covers macOS ADE on macOS 26+

The archive now documents Platform SSO registration during macOS Automated Device Enrollment for macOS 26 and later when Company Portal 5.2604.0 or later is deployed. The documented setup uses specified Settings Catalog and ADE policies.

Intune · General

Windows script targeting and protected-app references expand

The November 16 service-release index calls out PowerShell script group exclusions and built-in group targeting on Windows. It also lists 10 newly available protected apps: EnGlobe Mobile, Everbridge 360, Hypergate Files for Intune, Newcode, Ramp, Reliaquest GreyMatter, Rogo AI, Rogo AI (Intune Wrapped), ShareCRM, and Zoho Mail - Intune.

Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment

Windows Autopilot guidance distinguishes recovery-key access by ownership

For affected reused Windows Autopilot devices, non-owner IT administrators retain recovery-key access. An administrator who owns the device faces the same BitLocker self-service restriction as a user, even with administrative permissions, and must contact IT assistance for the recovery key.

item.title: Windows maintenance windows and Android local actions get detailed Intune setup guidance — 14 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 14 November 2026

Windows maintenance windows and Android local actions get detailed Intune setup guidance

The 14 November update set is documentation-led: two new Intune pages and 23 updates, alongside one Windows Autopilot update. The most operationally significant changes cover Windows Update scheduling, Android event-driven actions, update-ring restart controls, an iOS/iPadOS enrollment workaround, and the shift from “Proactive Remediations” to “Remediations.”

Intune · Device updates

Maintenance-window guidance defines Windows Update scheduling prerequisites

The new Intune guidance explains one-time and recurring maintenance windows that control when automatic Windows Update downloads, installations, and update-related restarts can begin, using each device’s local time. The documented prerequisite is Windows 11 version 24H2 with KB5077181 and build 26100.7840 or later; the guidance recommends testing on representative devices before broad assignment, particularly for kiosks, shared devices, and manufacturing equipment.

Intune · Android

Android local actions guidance covers event-driven device responses

The new page documents Local actions profiles for dedicated or fully managed Android Enterprise devices. Events include device reboots, Managed Home Screen sign-ins, and power-connection changes; responses can launch apps, send broadcasts, sign out users, or exit kiosk mode. Activity actions require Overlay Permission granted through OEMConfig.

Intune · Device updates

Update-ring guidance separates quality and feature update controls

The refreshed settings reference now treats quality and feature updates separately and documents deadline, grace-period, and automatic-reboot settings for both, with related CSP references. It also recommends short quality-update deferrals and appropriate grace periods, giving administrators clearer guidance for configuring update timing and restart behavior.

Intune · Device enrollment

iOS enrollment guidance adds recovery steps for a one-time Entra join failure

The iOS/iPadOS enrollment guide now documents a possible one-time Microsoft Entra ID join failure. A manual device sync resolves the issue for future enrollments, while adding the Microsoft Intune Certificate Authority client production app is provided as an alternative workaround.

Intune · Troubleshooting

Remediations replaces Proactive Remediations in administrator guidance

The Deploy Remediations article replaces “Proactive Remediations” with “Remediations,” updates the admin center navigation path, and revises guidance covering requirements, scripting, privacy, and built-in packages. Administrators should use the updated terminology and navigation when locating and deploying script packages.

item.title: Configuration Manager 2609 unpublished after discovery issue; ODBC 18.7.1.1 can block upgrades — 12 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 12 November 2026

item.description:

item.title: iOS 27 shifts software updates to DDM as Intune ends legacy ADE authentication — 30 October 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 30 October 2026

iOS 27 shifts software updates to DDM as Intune ends legacy ADE authentication

The meaningful Intune changes center on retiring legacy Apple enrollment and update controls, alongside tighter Windows deployment options. Apple’s OS 27 guidance moves administrators to Declarative Device Management (DDM) for software updates, while the October 2026 (2610) release ends Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for ADE with user affinity. Windows Autopilot guidance adds Enterprise App Management app gating and sets a processing cutoff for older Active Directory connectors. Most of the period’s 3,079 updates were mechanical metadata or link changes, particularly in Configuration Manager.

Intune · Device updates

Apple moves iOS/iPadOS software-update controls to DDM

The planning guidance states that Apple deprecated MDM-based software-update workloads and removed related commands with OS 27. It directs administrators to Software Update enforcement and Software Update Settings, with enforcement based on each device’s local time zone.

Intune · Device enrollment

Intune ends Setup Assistant legacy authentication for ADE user affinity

Support for Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for Automated Device Enrollment with user affinity ended in the October 2026 (2610) service release. Existing profiles are automatically updated to modern authentication, and the legacy option is no longer available.

Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment

Older Intune AD connectors can no longer process Autopilot enrollments

Intune Connector for Active Directory versions older than 6.2501.2000.5 are deprecated and can no longer process enrollment requests. Connector version 6.2504.2001.8 uses WebView2, removing the documented need to disable Internet Explorer Enhanced Security Configuration on Windows Server.

Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment

Autopilot device preparation can gate setup on Enterprise App Management apps

Windows Autopilot device preparation policies can select Microsoft Intune Enterprise App Management auto-update apps and block setup until those apps are installed, allowing selected required applications to be present before users reach the desktop.

Intune · General

In-development guidance details a Defender Safe Deployment template

Intune’s in-development guidance describes a dedicated template for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint safe deployment settings on Windows, including separate update channels for platform, engine, and security intelligence updates.

item.description:
Day in brief · 29 September 2026

VPP token reuse can erase available assignments, Intune guidance warns

The period is dominated by documentation consolidation, but several updates have direct operational value. Apple guidance now warns about losing available app assignments when an existing VPP token is re-uploaded for DDM, and clarifies that app configuration policies support MDM-managed apps only. New Intune guidance also documents device renaming, editable device properties, and inventory collection timing. Most other edits correct URLs or reflect the current device-overview action paths, such as Remove data > Retire and Secure > Rotate FileVault recovery key.

Intune · App management

VPP guidance warns against re-uploading tokens for DDM

The Manage VPP for Apple guidance says re-uploading an existing VPP token for DDM causes available app assignments to be lost. It recommends creating a new Apple Business token for DDM, while using MDM for available assignments and apps that require app configuration policies. Administrators should not re-upload tokens that already have available assignments.

Intune · App management

iOS and iPadOS app configuration is documented as MDM-only

The managed iOS guidance now states that app configuration policies support only MDM-managed apps and cannot configure DDM apps. The setup procedure was also renumbered, so DDM apps requiring this configuration path need a different management approach.

Intune · General

New guidance documents device renaming rules and limitations

The new rename-device article covers renaming managed devices from the Intune admin center, supported platforms, platform-specific naming rules, and bulk-renaming variables. It explicitly documents that hybrid-joined Windows devices aren't supported, which should be accounted for when standardizing inventory names.

Intune · Tenant administration

New Properties guidance covers editable device metadata

A new article explains how to edit a managed device's name, ownership, primary user, notes, and scope tags from the Properties tab. Scope-tag changes affect device visibility for delegated administrators, while the primary-user workflow is now documented alongside the other editable properties.

Intune · Device configuration

Inventory guidance sets a 24-hour initial collection window

The Collect device properties guidance now says active devices collect inventory multiple times per day, while initial collection can take up to 24 hours because full synchronization runs once daily. Administrators should allow that window before treating missing initial inventory as a problem.
